restore_checkpoint: restore a model checkpoint from the latest step in a given directory path using a checkpointer
remove_optimizer_state: remove the optimizer state dictionary from a checkpoint to reduce size before saving or loading
remove_pos_embed: remove the posembed_encoder from a checkpoint when its positional embedding shape mismatches the current optimizer
refactor_restore_checkpoint: refactor the restore_checkpoint function to support loading a specific checkpoint step instead of the latest
review_remove_pos_embed: review the remove_pos_embed function to handle additional encoder types beyond img_encoder
